findings.title: The cash composition table in client-cash-trend.tsx duplicates the drilldown table JSX already shipped in client-income-expense-chart.tsx
findings.evidence:
Both files render a near-identical shape: SectionHeader + DataTableCard + TableHeader/TableRow, one row per composition account with an account-code/name cell, a movement cell, an entries
    whose each
  • is a Link via entryHref(clientId, e.entryId) with formatDay/fmtCents/memo, a per-row entries-truncated

    , and a compositionTruncated

    below the table. client-cash-trend.tsx's version differs only by inserting a Balance cell (closingCents) and a Reason cell (memberReasonKey), and by using cashDrilldown.* message keys instead of drilldown.*. The two blocks were built independently (per the #1001 report, 'mirrors the profit side') rather than sharing a component.
findings.how_to_fix: Extract the shared row/table shape into one component (e.g. a `CompositionTable` taking `composition`, `clientId`, an optional list of extra leading/trailing cell renderers, and its own i18n namespace) and call it from both client-cash-trend.tsx and client-income-expense-chart.tsx, the same way entryHref itself was already extracted and reused rather than re-spelled.

findings.title: isEdit is switched on at four separate sites in ClientCashSetDialog (title/description text, the whole DialogBody content, the submit() branch, and the footer button label)
findings.evidence: `isEdit ? t("cashSet.editTitle") : t("cashSet.dialogTitle")`, `isEdit ? (loading...) : loading ? ... : ...` (the whole body), `isEdit ? {...} : {...}` inside submit(), and `isEdit ? (saving ? ... : ...) : (saving ? ... : ...)` in the footer button all re-test the same boolean across the file.
findings.how_to_fix: Fowler's fix is polymorphism or one shared map both sites read from; here that likely means splitting the two modes into two small render functions (or two sibling components sharing only the Dialog chrome) keyed off isEdit once, rather than re-branching on it at each of the four sites.
findings.note: The ticket's own AC6 requires the first-publish branch be literally untouched byte-for-byte, which is plausibly why the implementer kept it as an inline sibling branch inside the same file/JSX tree rather than refactoring into a shared abstraction — worth weighing against the smell rather than a blind extraction.

findings.title: Commit cb8040d54 lands the whole 8-cell test file and the whole component implementation together, so red-before-green per slice is not independently auditable from git history
findings.evidence: git show --stat cb8040d54 shows client-cash-set-dialog.test.tsx (341 lines, new) and client-cash-set-dialog.tsx (255 lines changed) landing in the same commit, with no intermediate commits showing individual red/green cycles for the six new AC-named cells.
findings.how_to_fix: Not a correctness problem (the tests themselves are independent-literal, non-tautological, and drive the public component interface — verified by rerun, 8/8 pass) and the work order permits 'a small group of slices' per commit; flagged only because it removes the audit trail rule 4 asks for ('one test -> red -> minimal green -> next test'), distinct from the true anti-pattern (a battery of red tests committed before any implementation), which this is NOT.
findings.overridden_by: WORK-ORDER.md rule 4: 'Commit per green slice or per small group of slices' explicitly permits this shape.
